basis: Individually inspected half-open finite sum/product spans. Bound-expression grammar and shared arithmetic/callback callees are separately inventoried; calls do not imply understanding of unlisted callees.

ranges.scope: Scalar signed integral-bound gate and packed-BCD exponent<10 check
Complete finite product: bound parsing contract, inclusive ascending X, cancel checks, expression callback, per-step numeric cleanup, overflow/errors and final decimal marker clearing
Complete finite sum: bound parsing contract, inclusive ascending X, cancel checks, expression callback, per-step numeric cleanup, overflow/errors and scalar result return
